shadows.name: surface-low
shadows.purpose: Advanced settings popovers; permanent task configuration stays flat.

shadows.name: surface-low-dark
shadows.purpose: Advanced settings popovers in dark mode.

motion.name: quick
motion.purpose: Hover, press, config mode changes and popover close.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Violet primary action with short press feedback.
components.css: .ui-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: #6957e8; color: #fff; font: 600 13px system-ui; transition: background-color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ui-button:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.985); } .ui-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(105 87 232 / 18%); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ui-button { transition: none; } }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: Full-height sidebar, 208px expanded and 68px collapsed; macOS collapsed width is 80px. Active rows use a neutral background.
components.css: .sidebar { width: 208px; padding: 12px; box-sizing: border-box; background: #f5f5f7; border-right: 1px solid #e5e4eb; } .sidebar-link { display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; height: 38px; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; font: 500 13px system-ui; text-align: left; -webkit-app-region: no-drag; } .sidebar-link-active { background: #e6e6ec; color: #242330; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Desktop Window Chrome
components.description: Independent 56px workspace header shows the current page and unfinished task count. Windows reserves 156px for native controls; Linux retains its system titlebar.
components.html: 图片处理2 个任务未完成
components.css: .app-titlebar { display: flex; height: 56px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 0 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e3e2ea; background: #fff; color: #1c1b27; font: 13px system-ui; -webkit-app-region: drag; } .app-titlebar strong { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; } .app-titlebar span { color: #6d6b7c; font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Drop Workspace
components.description: Continuous workspace with 20px top, 24px horizontal and 16px bottom padding. Flat scrollable configuration occupies at most 60% of the height.
components.html:
处理设置
拖入图片或文件夹
components.css: .video-drop-workspace { display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 240px; min-height: 0; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 20px 24px 16px; background: #fff; color: #1c1b27; font: 13px system-ui; } .video-config-panel { flex-shrink: 0; max-height: 60%; overflow: auto; border-bottom: 1px solid #e3e2ea; padding-bottom: 16px; } .video-workspace-content { flex: 1; min-height: 0; padding-top: 16px; }

components.name: Surface Panel
components.description: Flat settings surface; task tables have a separate 10px border radius and configuration has no nested panel.
components.css: .settings-card { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; padding: 18px; border: 1px solid #e3e2ea; border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; color: #1c1b27; font: 13px system-ui; box-shadow: none; } .settings-card h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Semantic Status
components.description: Task states use text and icons with theme-aware semantic colors; queued tasks are distinct from files not yet submitted.
components.css: .badge-success { display: inline-flex; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: #e8f8ef; color: #18794e; font: 500 12px system-ui; }

narrative.overview: A calm desktop media workstation with a full-height sidebar, independent workspace header and continuous file, configuration and result areas. Violet marks primary actions and progress; spacing and thin dividers establish hierarchy.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral navigation selection with violet icons and primary actions

rules.name: Signal Rarity
rules.body: Violet marks interaction and progress; navigation selection uses a neutral background and violet icon. Lime is reserved for activity signals.

rules.name: Flat at Rest
rules.body: Permanent surfaces use tone or border; shadows are reserved for true elevation.

dos: Keep files, configuration, task state and results visually connected.
Calibrate light and dark themes independently.
donts: Do not use decorative gradients, glass or glowing edges.
Do not fill workspaces with unrelated metric cards.
